reference_aliases: Cards refer to actual Velluneo refs, not TI example numbering. Numeric search weights do not come from TI.
status: Preparation only; not approved spatial constraints or routing adapter input.

cards.instruction: Minimize primary power loop. Keep IC/signal return out of Q1/R9 pulse-current path; signal and power grounds meet at C1 negative. Model real vias/width/copper heating, not just straight links.

At least one bypass must be physically local to U1.1/4 with short return. Final proposal establishes1.412mm projected endpoints on opposite faces, but vias and physical loop remain to qualify. Exact effective bypass and startup charge remain source-bound; do not replace C0G by an unqualified tiny ceramic.
Place R4/R5 VS junction near U1.2 and quiet GND. Keep away from DRAIN/CLAMP; short direct VS route, avoid parallel high-dv/dt conductors.
Dedicated sense takeoff at R9 pads and quiet return. No shared gate/power current in CS branch; verify actual R6 placement and full source/ground loop.
Compact gate loop with defined source return and R7 near gate. Native Q1.2/4 are same DRAIN, not duplicate independent devices.
Short clamp connections; retain dynamic VDS/TVS/leakage/fault bounds. No assumption that cold static TVS or nominal leakage qualifies MOS SOA.
Compact rectifier/charge loop, local bias filtering; include finite P/A/S coupling and actual HV startup source in startup/retry assessment.
Compact secondary rectification loop and local output cap. Output J2 wires/strain relief and abuse states stay explicit; do not infer a selected dock from wire pads.
RT1 position must follow actual thermal hotspot, gradient and lag; short trace alone is insufficient. Open sensor removes channel; independent backup candidate not applied.

Maintain all-path air/surface/solid insulation to adopted actual source limits. Planning9.35mm projected metal distance is not a normative pass; NC pads and core/yokes are included in physical assessment.
